label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter flows directly into a StringBuilder via append(param), which then becomes the response body printed without any HTML encoding or context-aware escaping. The X-XSS-Protection header being set to "0" disables browser-level XSS protections, confirming the intent to reflect unencoded content. Since the sink is writing arbitrary user input to the HTTP response body, this constitutes a genuine cross-site scripting vulnerability.

evidence.note: Parameter extracted from request maps to bar via StringBuilder append, then written to response writer without encoding
